subject: Eval handoff: security checklist, retention detail & DPA edits
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@regulabank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@regulabank.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff — SOC 2 / retention questions

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo today. Procurement asked me to get a clearer view of the security/compliance gates we need to hit before we can sign. Two quick asks so we can finalize the MAP on our side: 

1) SOC 2 — do you have the most recent Type II report we can share with our InfoSec team? They also want to know whether Redwood's monitoring/alerting scope includes platform-level log retention (how long, where stored).

2) SIG/CAIQ — is there an up-to-date answers spreadsheet we can review? Our security reviewer will perform a gap analysis and may request follow-up controls evidence.

Finally, procurement would like a draft DPA (we can redline) and a proposed data retention policy for customer data processed through Redwood Private/Dedicated. Can you share those items and a suggested go-to-close timeline? We're shooting for a mid-December close but need these artifacts to get internal approvals.

Appreciate a brief checklist + timeline if possible.

Best,
Samantha Liu
Senior IT Risk Manager
RegulaBank
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@regulabank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff — SOC 2 / retention questions

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Attaching the items below and proposing a compact MAP to get you to mid-December close. Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_Attest_2025.pdf, SIG-CAIQ_Answers_Redwood_2026.xlsx, Draft_DPA_Redwood-RegulaBank_2026-11-30.docx.

Proposed MAP highlights (high level):
- Week of Dec 1: RegulaBank reviews SOC 2 + SIG answers. Procurement to circulate DPA redlines by Dec 3.
- Week of Dec 6: Engineering evidence Q&A (we can host a 60-min controls deep-dive on Dec 7).
- Week of Dec 13: Final DPA sign and product/ops readiness check (demo of retention controls & log export).
- Dec 15–17: Legal signoff and DocuSign. Target: Dec 17 close.

Retention specifics: Redwood retains platform logs for 90 days by default (aggregated metrics 2 years); customer data retention is configurable per deployment — for Redwood Private/Dedicated we surface a retention window in the deployment config and can support 30/90/365-day retention policies. Long-term archives need an agreed SLA and may add operational runbooks; see the short summary in the attached DPA draft (section 4).

SIG/CAIQ notes: the spreadsheet contains our current answers and links to evidence artifacts. If your reviewer flags gaps we’ll triage with Rishi (security engineering) and schedule evidence pulls.

Next steps I propose:
1) Samantha — can procurement send DPA redlines by EOD Dec 3?
2) Marissa — can you schedule the controls deep-dive with Rishi for Dec 7 (60 min)?
3) Ben — can you prepare a 15-min demo of the retention/export controls for Dec 13 readiness check?

If that timeline looks tight we can shift sign to Dec 21, but we should confirm cadence today.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@regulabank.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff — SOC 2 / retention questions

Ack — scheduled controls deep-dive: Dec 7, 14:00–15:00 PT (Zoom link in calendar invite). Rishi — will you lead the technical evidence walk? I’ll own notes and action items.

Ben — I added you to the Dec 13 slot for the retention demo (15 minutes + 10 min Q&A). Samantha — please confirm procurement DPA timeline — if we have redlines by Dec 3 we’ll push the draft into DocuSign on the 14th to keep the Dec 17 target.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@regulabank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@regulabank.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff — SOC 2 / retention questions

Thanks — that schedule works. Procurement confirmed they’ll send initial DPA redlines by COB Dec 3. A couple quick clarifications before the controls deep-dive: 

• For the SOC 2 report — does the attestation cover Redwood Private deployments or only the hosted API? (our security team needs Private covered as part of the contract)
• On retention: can you confirm whether logs containing customer-identifying metadata are included in the 90-day retention, or are those purged earlier? We need that specifically called out in the DPA.

I’ll loop in our legal if redlines include non-standard clauses; procurement will upload the redline doc to DocuSign when ready.

Best,
Samantha
--- End of thread ---
